title: Core: AS2 Number and Boolean class conversions
description: Test compilation of: Number(x), Number('123'), String(n), String(true), Boolean(0), Boolean(''), Boolean(null), parseInt('0xFF', 16), parseFloat('3.14'), isNaN(x), isFinite(x), Number.MAX_VALUE, Number.MIN_VALUE, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY. Each should compile. Verify typeof-related opcodes.
